ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the graph: in the figure the vertical axis is labeled v, the horizontal axis is labeled t, the origin is O, and t1 is marked on the horizontal axis. In the time interval from 0 to t1 there are two arched v-t curves, the upper curve is labeled “A”, and the lower curve is labeled “B”; from the graph, within the interval 0<t<t1, the velocity curve of A lies above the velocity curve of B, and at the endpoints the two may be equal. Then reason: the problem statement explains that A and B do linear motion in the same direction, and the area under the curve in a v-t graph represents displacement. Therefore within 0～t1 there is vA≥vB, and within the interior of the interval vA>vB, that is, the rate of change of the displacement difference of the two objects is positive within the interior of the interval; equivalently, the part by which the area under A's curve exceeds the area under B's curve will continuously accumulate and become larger with time. Therefore within the time 0～t1, the displacement difference of the two objects must continuously increase.
